Name: HSR Cat Cake Furniture
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCrfQoK.png[/img]
Honkai Star Rail's cat cakes (officially known as "Ruan Mei's creations") have found their way into Stardew Valley! This mod adds the ten special creations from HSR's Critter Pick event that are based on playable characters as furniture to Stardew.

Cat cakes can be bought from either Robin, Marnie or the traveling cart (configurable using GMCM), though it's random which one is offered each day. Simply come back and check the shop on a different day when you have the chance – after all, you've gotta collect 'em all, right? Each cake comes with its own name, flavor text and sprite (duh).

They have a 2x2 "footprint" and are consequently much larger than HSR's original cat cakes. In exchange for lore accuracy, however, you can now sit on them as long as you click on the top two tiles.

If you've got any feedback or want to tell me I did a great job, please just leave a comment and I'll get back to you as soon as possible. Additionally, if you like this mod, here's a little selfish request: Please consider endorsing it. It makes it easier for others to find it, it's free and easy to do and it even makes me happy, too. Win-win-win? Last but not least, if you have any screenshots showing how you decorated something with these cakes/cats, please share them! I don't exactly have a talent for decorating, so I'd greatly appreciate any pics to put in the image section.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sgtIh0y.png[/img]
